exploit_name: Oracle manipulation via insufficient historical tick validation
description: Oracle implementation allows price manipulation through insufficient validation of historical tick data or insufficient protection against rapid sequential updates.
root_cause: Oracle implementation allows price manipulation through insufficient validation of historical tick data or insufficient protection against rapid sequential updates.
fix_description: Implement stricter validation of oracle updates, add rate-limiting on sequential updates.
notes: Attacker can influence liquidation decisions, solvency checks, and pricing calculations.
